verdict.rationale: Docs show `$skill-installer` and CLI commands like `codex plugin marketplace add` that can be run non-interactively/headlessly, and a probe confirms a real keyless CLI install (`npx -y skills add ... -a codex -y --copy`) landing a valid SKILL.md without prompts, demonstrating an agent can script an install end to end. missing for 10: no first-party Codex CLI doc explicitly showing a fully promptless one-liner install flag (e.g. `-y`) native to `codex` itself, and no independent (non-probe) confirmation of headless success across multiple skills.
